evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence

observations.why: Frames intelligence in ownership-vs-rental terms, a proportionality/possession-value contrast rather than hierarchy or pooling.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Enacts a value-differentiation move — commodity vs. kept asset — a market-pricing style proportionality between disposable and retained value.
